title: Campus Factor for Observation and Emergency Small Items — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Finance schedule.** The small-item campus factor multiplies the whole observation small-item value of an observation or emergency account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) on an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing):

| Campus | Factor |
|---|---|
| Riverbend Lakeshore Hospital - Neenah | 0.9 |
| Riverbend Community Hospital - Chilton | 1.05 |
| otherwise (Riverbend Regional Medical Center - Appleton) | 1 |

Example (hypothetical): a value of 40.00 becomes 36.00 at Neenah, 42.00 at Chilton and stays 40.00 at Appleton.
